description: This file defines the TransfersDataValidator class, which provides validation logic for various transfer-related operations in the Fineract system. It validates JSON input for operations such as transferring clients between groups, proposing, accepting, rejecting, and withdrawing client transfers, ensuring required parameters are present and correctly formatted.

classes.name: TransfersDataValidator
classes.description: A validation component for various client transfer operations, ensuring JSON inputs meet the required parameter and data constraints before processing.

methods.name: validateForClientsTransferBetweenGroups
methods.description: Validates input JSON for transferring clients between groups, checking required parameters and their correctness.

methods.name: validateForProposeClientTransfer
methods.description: Validates JSON for proposing a client transfer, ensuring destination office ID and note are valid.

methods.name: validateForAcceptClientTransfer
methods.description: Validates JSON for accepting a client transfer, validating optional fields like new staff ID and destination group ID.

methods.name: validateForProposeAndAcceptClientTransfer
methods.description: Validates JSON for simultaneous propose and accept transfer actions, checking multiple parameters.

methods.name: validateForRejectClientTransfer
methods.description: Validates JSON for rejecting a client transfer, primarily validating the note parameter.

methods.name: validateForWithdrawClientTransfer
methods.description: Validates JSON for withdrawing a client transfer, primarily validating the note parameter.

methods.name: private validateNote
methods.description: Checks that the note parameter does not exceed length constraints.
